answer: Attention-Backed Queueing Rights: each identity must hold a continuous, audited stream of real-time task attention to remain eligible for agent work. Enforcement samples response latency on a quartz-timed schedule; gaps beyond a threshold suspend the identity. An attacker operating many identities must staff genuine parallel attention, paying the opportunity cost of foregone work on a karst-like uneven demand surface. Each false identity thus costs sustained human-equivalent attention per knoll of verified activity, making mass proliferation economically irrational.
